checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No basic services line item with its own price is present; the list uses basic fee included in casket prices, so the condition is not met.
No second mandatory fee for staff, facilities or overhead is printed; only the basic services fee built into casket prices is described.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container and alternative container options; no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions transportation and cremation but no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and other mentioned services are part of allowed basic-fee or required-item descriptions.
No optional combination package at one price is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires purchase of any item beyond the prescribed disclosure wording.
No claim that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances is printed.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and no required disclosure is printed in a way that is hard to notice.
